coder_notes: Feasibility pilot of CMV pp65 RNA-pulsed DC vaccine during adjuvant temozolomide. DC vaccine and Td booster are excluded intervention types. GM-CSF is part of the registered vaccine intervention (adjuvant) and was coded excluded_intervention_type with uncertain flag; if adjudicated as a pharmacological candidate, S6 would pass. 'WHO Grade IV glioma' without IDH requirement -> cns5_terminology historical. CMV pp65 is a vaccine antigen, not recorded as a tumour biomarker. Temozolomide timing is adjusted around vaccines (cycles every 5 weeks) but it is ongoing standard adjuvant therapy, not the question -> soc_backbone.
